name: prompt-glance
description: A two-row HUD above the Claude Code prompt: model, path and git branch, context and plan-window gauges that warm from green to red, prompt-cache hit rate with a live countdown to expiry, and the tools and skills in use. Folds to fewer rows on a narrow terminal. /cache opens a per-turn cache table.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the cache lives after a request: auto follows Claude Code's own rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1 hour on a Claude subscription and 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

warnSeconds.title: Warn before expiry (s)
warnSeconds.description: Seconds left on the countdown at which the band turns yellow and a toast reminds you the cache is about to lapse

compactAtTokens.title: Large context (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: From this prompt size up, an expired cache suggests /compact (or /clear) before you pay to write the whole prefix again

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the meter as a row above the prompt

status.title: Status line entry
status.description: Also pin a short entry (hit rate and countdown) under the prompt

toast.title: Toast near expiry
toast.description: Toasts as the cache lapses: at the warning threshold, then at 10, 3, 2 and 1 seconds, once per cache entry each (only for prompts of 20k tokens or more)
